summary: Add pkg/automation/mcpops: MCP operations of automations for agents (automation_catalog, automation_list, automation_get, automation_runs, automation_run_get, automation_validate, automation_dry_run as read-only tools; automation.create/update/layout as guarded changes; HUMAN_REQUIRED for enabling, deciding tasks and managing connections). workflow.NativeContract.HumanOnly marks native contracts (automation.run, automation.call) whose instances and tasks the extruntime MCP workflow actions refuse with HUMAN_REQUIRED by default (after the action's own RBAC check), and whose payloads ext_workflow_get/ext_workflow_list leave out. Engine: DryRunInput.MaxCalls/RealCalls (ErrLimitExceeded), engine.WithTx (writes and reads in the caller's transaction; Disable/Delete in it leave the cancellation to Maintain), Get/GetVersion admit Automations.Author. graph.ExecAnswer.Script, mcp.Audit, changes.Applied.Result returned in the receipt item while the caller passes the kind policy; every applied change is an audit event stored with the receipt (mcp.operation_audit) and delivered idempotently (changes.Config.Auditor, mcp.AuditorFrom, AuditEntry.Item).
